rift.name: Space-Time Rift
rift.description: Recurring cross-faction incursions: portals open every 3 hours and send Elyos into Asmodian territory (and vice versa) — the only way to enter the opposing faction's lands. Open-world PvPvE, separate from the Abyss. PvP is opt-in; unflagged players cannot be attacked. Portal usable for 10 minutes, stay up to 1 hour, 240-player cap per portal.

events.name: Trick or Treat — Halloween Event
events.summary: Halloween 2026 on Global: a 14-day Trick or Treat login track (35 Pumpkin Coins/day, +100 bonus on days 7 and 14 → 620 total), 10 repeatable weekly Season Missions (~235 coins/week), Candy Keys crafted from 60 dungeon fragments (1 per colour per server per week, Wednesday reset — Blue candy is the best value), and a Pumpkin Coin shop. The shop stays open until Nov 24.
rewards: Special Halloween Chest (skeleton breastplate skin) — 250 coins
Cash-shop outfits, Spider Wings, Pumpkin Carriage (until Nov 24)

gearTransfer.summary: Gear Transfer moves investment from one piece of gear to another (the donor is consumed). It carries Enhancement level and Soul Binding lines — plus Amplification — but loses Potential rolls, Manastones, Theostones and the Philosopher's Stone line. It unlocks at character level 45 and only works between items soul-bound to the same character. ilvl 70 is the community's "first keeper tier": the first gear worth transferring into.
rules: Carried over: Enhancement level, Soul Binding lines, Amplification. Lost: Potential, Manastones, Theostones, Philosopher's Stone line.
The destination cannot already have a fixed Soul Binding, and 4→5 lines rolls the 5th free while 5→3 keeps only the first three.
Soul-binding lines keep the same percentage of the item's max roll — the same line is worth more on an ilvl 70 base, which is why ilvl 70 (Aulamus, Vakron, crafted T1.5) is the first keeper tier.
No official NCSoft rules page exists — these rules are community-verified; always read the preview window before confirming.
